packageRules.description: This repo dogfoods couch-kit: track every @couch-kit package in one PR and auto-merge non-major updates once CI (including the APK check) passes.

Android native stack: Nitro, Expo, React Native and native modules. Grouped so the APK check runs once per batch; never auto-merged, because native ABI drift (nitro-http-server vs nitro-modules, July 2026) does not show up in typecheck or unit tests.
Web toolchain and test runner: open PRs, review manually.
Hold every major update for manual review.
